title: Realistic mixed learner
goal: Clarifies, hedges, jumps topics once, recovers after a follow-up, one off-topic aside, asks for the plan again, then bye.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you plan to do about Jamie
examples: Was it the same kind of mistake each week, or different ones?
I'd write down the mistakes, six weeks out of eight, and talk to her about them.
Oh, and I wanted to ask about Dylan's reports too, but go on.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll put in
examples: I'd add more about what everyone worked on this half.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what would show customers are staying
examples: I'd start with how many customers we kept compared with last half, then add a few things the team did that helped.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll say to Chloe
examples: I'd talk to her this week, privately.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'd actually say
examples: I'd catch her this week, just the two of us. I'd say, On that call last week you jumped in a few times and the client went quiet after that. Next time, try letting them finish first.
Do clients always get this picky? Anyway,

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll do about Dylan
intents.do: Ask one question about the software
examples: Is it just Dylan who struggles with it, or others too?
I'd get him trained on the software, ask for the report on time from next week, and check in with him every week for a month.

intents.do: Ask the plan again then bye
examples: Sorry, can you say the plan again? ... Okay, thanks, bye.
